```python
import json
from collections import Counter, namedtuple

Item = namedtuple("Item", "size origin kind material smell color")

data = """xxl|Mexican|camera|ceramic|leather
xxl|British|drill|concrete|chocolate
xl|Brazilian|bag|steel|leather
small|Portuguese|stapler|steel|lavender
xxs|Brazilian|fork|plastic|coffee
xxs|Brazilian|fork|plastic|burning wood
xxl|Japanese|scissors|plastic|baking bread
small|French|ruler|steel|vinegar
large|Afghan|bicycle|ceramic|pine needles
xxl|Canadian|camera|plastic|coconut
xxs|Spanish|shirt|plastic|gasoline
small|Chinese|watch|plastic|vanilla
xl|Canadian|pen|plastic|lavender
xs|Afghan|piano|ceramic|citrus fruits
small|Canadian|earring|plastic|popcorn
xxl|Afghan|table|steel|baking bread
xs|Spanish|calculator|ceramic|freshly cut grass
large|Mexican|ball|steel|freshly cut grass
medium|German|screwdriver|steel|burning wood
xxs|Turkish|bag|glass|coffee
xl|Turkish|bottle|concrete|popcorn
small|French|table|plastic|coconut
small|French|wrench|concrete|vanilla
xs|Turkish|cup|concrete|coconut
xxl|French|guitar|ceramic|lavender
medium|Spanish|sofa|ceramic|vanilla
large|Mexican|clock|ceramic|burning wood
xxs|Turkish|screwdriver|ceramic|lavender
xxl|Spanish|lamp|concrete|vinegar
small|German|pen|steel|garlic
xs|Chinese|pen|ceramic|burning wood
large|Polish|umbrella|steel|popcorn
xs|Chinese|sofa|ceramic|freshly cut grass
xxl|Iranian|bottle|concrete|baking bread
xl|Turkish|screwdriver|glass|leather
xl|Afghan|shoe|plastic|coconut
medium|French|clock|glass|garlic
xxl|Mexican|table|steel|garlic
medium|French|bowl|ceramic|wet dog
xs|Russian|box|ceramic|rose
xs|Portuguese|shirt|plastic|leather
large|Spanish|watch|steel|pine needles
xs|Russian|vase|ceramic|vanilla
xl|Italian|wrench|plastic|lavender
xl|Afghan|saw|steel|coffee
medium|French|marker|ceramic|rose
xs|Japanese|wallet|ceramic|garlic
xxl|Chinese|screwdriver|glass|gasoline
small|Portuguese|calculator|plastic|burning wood"""

color_runs = [
    ("beige", 1), ("black", 2), ("blue", 5), ("brown", 3),
    ("crimson", 2), ("cyan", 2), ("gold", 3), ("green", 1),
    ("ivory", 2), ("khaki", 1), ("magenta", 2), ("maroon", 2),
    ("orange", 4), ("pink", 1), ("purple", 2), ("red", 3),
    ("silver", 3), ("teal", 2), ("turquoise", 1), ("violet", 1),
    ("white", 3), ("yellow", 3),
]
colors = [color for color, count in color_runs for _ in range(count)]
rows = [line.split("|") for line in data.splitlines()]
assert len(rows) == len(colors) == 49
initial = [Item(*row, color) for row, color in zip(rows, colors)]

discarded_smells = {"baking bread", "coffee", "wet dog"}
survivors = [x for x in initial if x.smell not in discarded_smells]
required_materials = Counter({
    "ceramic": 14, "concrete": 4, "steel": 6, "glass": 11, "plastic": 7
})
initial_pairs = {(x.smell, x.color) for x in initial}

def qualifies(x):
    return (
        x.color != "blue"
        and x.size != "xxl"
        and x.material != "plastic"
        and x.smell != "citrus fruits"
        and x.origin != "Canadian"
    )

possible_answers = set()
evidence = []
for material in required_materials:
    after_aunt = [
        x._replace(material=material, smell="lavender")
        if x.size == "small" else x
        for x in survivors
    ]
    if Counter(x.material for x in after_aunt) != required_materials:
        continue

    after_uncle = []
    for x in after_aunt:
        if x.origin == "Japanese":
            after_uncle.extend([
                x._replace(origin="Turkish"),
                x._replace(origin="French"),
            ])
        else:
            after_uncle.append(x)

    type_counts = Counter(x.kind for x in after_uncle)
    after_parity = [
        x for x in after_uncle if type_counts[x.kind] % 2 == 1
    ]

    added = [
        x for x in after_parity
        if (x.smell, x.color) not in initial_pairs
    ]
    before_loss = after_parity + added

    # Exhaust every possible identity of the lost extra-extra-large item.
    loss_indices = [
        i for i, x in enumerate(before_loss) if x.size == "xxl"
    ]
    branch_answers = set()
    for i in loss_indices:
        current = before_loss[:i] + before_loss[i + 1:]
        branch_answers.add(sum(qualifies(x) for x in current))
    possible_answers.update(branch_answers)

    evidence.append({
        "aunt_material": material,
        "after_aunt": len(after_aunt),
        "after_uncle": len(after_uncle),
        "after_parity": len(after_parity),
        "copies_added": len(added),
        "possible_lost_items": len(loss_indices),
        "qualifying_counts": sorted(branch_answers),
    })

if not possible_answers:
    print("UNSUPPORTED")
else:
    answer = (
        str(next(iter(possible_answers)))
        if len(possible_answers) == 1 else "unknown"
    )
    print(json.dumps({
        "final_answer": answer,
        "evidence": {
            "initial_items": len(initial),
            "first_discarded": len(initial) - len(survivors),
            "branches": evidence,
        },
    }, separators=(",", ":")))
```
